item.tib: 'bum gzungs mdo gsum byams ma'i bon spyod
item.coloph: phyis khro tshang 'brug lhas zar gyis stag sna dang rtse sding yang dben nas gter du drangs te dmyal ston gzhon 'bum la sogs la gnang ba'o…
item.note: the dmyal-ston gzhon-nu 'bum mentioned in the colophon is the same as gnyal-ston gzhon-nu 'bum. he was an important person in the transmission of the various mother tantra cycles. the byams ma is considered to belong to the 'outer' mother tantra category.
